plugins.name: protect-main-branch
plugins.description: Prevent git operations that would modify the main branch (or configured branches) in Claude Code. Individual subcommands can be opted out via PROTECT_MAIN_BRANCH_ALLOWED_SUBCOMMANDS, or the hook can be turned off entirely for the current scope via PROTECT_MAIN_BRANCH_DISABLE.

plugins.name: session-handover
plugins.description: Job-succession handover/takeover for Claude Code. Each document represents a job seat identified by (project, role) frontmatter and lives at <base>/<holder>.md, where <holder> is the current holder's English first name. /handover writes a holder's handoff report (Knowledge block) and an append-only accountability ledger (History block). /takeover transfers the seat: the file is renamed <predecessor>.md -> <successor>.md, a takeover entry is appended to History, and the successor audits inherited claims before relying on them. Every referenced artifact — References entries and History [ref:] citations alike — is externalized into a mandatory read task and drained before any work starts; reading the inherited citations is not optional. Self/other boundary is preserved by design — the successor does not become the predecessor — so that critical verification of the predecessor's report stays sharp. Predecessor failures that surface during the successor's tenure become the successor's recovery work, per standard business succession discipline. <base> resolves deterministically via the bundled handover-dir command (walks up to the nearest .handover/, falls back to $HOME/.handover). v2.x .claude/handover/ layouts and v3.x description-only frontmatter are auto-migrated.

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Retrospective skill based on a 6-stage process (input → interpretation → planning → action → inspection → output) to surface problems and opportunities, and apply improvements. Bundles a single retrospective-critic agent invoked once at Submission for adversarial audit across six bias surfaces.

plugins.name: session-tts
plugins.description: Read Claude Code responses aloud locally with a different Japanese voice per session. Instructs Claude to deliver mid-turn progress narration via a synchronous Bash call into the say adapter, plus a TodoWrite hook that nudges narration at task transitions. Permission prompts include the workspace name. ON by default; playback volume is adjustable via /session-tts:volume. Engine and models are managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.

plugins.name: tech-writing
plugins.description: Japanese technical writing norms for books, articles, and documentation. Covers formatting (one sentence per line, footnotes, column headings), paragraph structure (paragraph writing), argumentative rigor, reader cognitive load management, perspective and narration, restraint in rhetoric, LLM-style filler prohibition, and redundancy elimination.

plugins.name: memory-sanitize
plugins.description: Reproducible Japanese prose quality checker for persistent layers (memory, CLAUDE.md, skill definitions, style guides). Combines textlint-ja rules with custom rules (em-dash prohibition, English word detection, heading separator ban) to enforce writing discipline. No auto-fix — detection only. Requires Node.js (npx).

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Knowledge base management skills for the LLM Wiki pattern (Karpathy-style). Provides ingest (project manifest changes → wiki pages), query (cross-project inventory questions), lint (OKF v0.1 conformance, broken links, staleness detection), and sync (re-ingest stale pages). The KB lives at ~/.knowledge/ with a raw/wiki two-layer OKF v0.1 layout.
